t: A rectangular courtyard is 4m 95cm long and 16m 65cm broad. It is to be paved with the square tiles of the same size. Find the least number of such square tiles required to pave the rectangular courtyard.
e: We are given a rectangular courtyard with dimensions: · Length = 4 m 95 cm · Breadth = 16 m 65 cm · We need to find the least number of square tiles required to completely pave the rectangular courtyard. Step 1: Convert the dimensions to a consistent unit (centimeters) · Length = 4 m 95 cm=495 cm (since 1 meter = 100 cm) · Breadth = 16 m 65 cm=1665 cm Step 2: Find the side length of the largest square tile The side length of the largest square tile that can tile the courtyard exactly will be the greatest common divisor (GCD) of the length and breadth of the courtyard, because the GCD represents the largest possible side length that can divide both dimensions without leaving a remainder. Now, find the GCD of 495 cm and 1665 cm Using the Euclidean algorithm to find the GCD: 1665÷495≈3(quotient)1665 1665−3 X 495=1665−1485=180 495÷180≈2(quotient) 495−2 X 180=495−360=135 180÷135≈1(quotient)180 180−1 X 135=180−135=45 135÷45=3(quotient) Since the remainder is now 0, the GCD is 45 cm. Step 3: Find the area of the courtyard The area of the courtyard is: Area of the courtyard=495 cm X 1665 cm=823,575 cm2 Step 4: Find the area of one square tile The area of one square tile with side length 45 cm is: Area of one square tile=45 cm X 45 cm=2025 cm2 Step 5: Find the number of tiles required To find the number of tiles required, divide the area of the courtyard by the area of one square tile: Number of tiles=Area of the courtyard/Area of one square tile=823,575/2025=407 Step 6: Conclusion Thus, the least number of square tiles required to pave the courtyard is 407. The correct answer is d) 407.

t: Areas of two circular fields are in the ratio 1: 4. e: Let radii of smaller and larger circular fields are r and R respectively. Now, 1: 4 = (πr2)/(πR2) => R = 2r New radius of field which was smaller earlier = (100 + 80)% of r = 1.8r New radius of field which was larger earlier = (100 - 40)% of R = 0.6R = 0.6 * 2r = 1.2r Therefore, required percentage = (new area of circular field which was smaller earlier)/(new area of circular field which was larger earlier) * 100 = (π * 1.8r * 1.8r)/(π * 1.2r * 1.2r) * 100 = 225%

t: A rectangular park is 60 m long and 40 m wide. A path of uniform width is constructed inside the park along its edges. If the area of the path is 384 m², find the width of the path.
e:
Total area of the park = 60 X 40 = 2400 m²
Let, x = width of the path
Then the inner rectangle has dimensions (60 - 2x) m and (40 - 2x) m.
Area of the inner rectangle = (60 - 2x)(40 - 2x) m²
Area of the path = Area of outer rectangle - Area of inner rectangle = 2400 - (60 - 2x)(40 - 2x) = 384
So,
(60 - 2x)(40 - 2x) = 2400 - 384 = 2016.
Take x = 2:
(60 - 2 X 2) = 56, (40 - 2 X 2) = 36 → 56 X 36 = 2016.
This satisfies the equation.
Therefore, x = 2 m

r = 70 m

t: The perimeter of a triangle is 30 cm and its area is numerically equal to the sum of its sides. If one of the sides measures 12 cm, what is the length (in cm) of the largest side of the triangle?
e:
Let the largest side of the triangle be x cm.
Given, one of the sides = 12 cm.
∴ The remaining two sides are x cm and (18 - x) cm.
Given, area of the triangle = perimeter
=> √{15(15 - 12)(15 - x)(15 - 18 + x)} = 30 [According to Heron's formula]
=> 15 * 3 * (15 - x) (x - 3) = 30 * 30
=> (15 - x)(x - 3) = 20
=> 15x - 45 - x² + 3x = 20
=> x² - 18x + 65 = 0
=> (x - 13)(x - 5) = 0
=> x = 13 cm (largest side of the triangle).

t: Three concentric circles are designed as part of a target practice board. Their diameters form an arithmetic progression. If the smallest circle has a circumference of 8π cm and the largest circle has the circumference of 20π cm, what is the circumference of the middle circle?
e:
using circumference of circle = 2πr (where r is radius)
ATQ,
Circumference of smaller circle = 8π
Now, let radius of smaller circle = r
2πr=8π
r=4
Similarly, according to question
2πr’ =20π (r’ radius of largest)
r’=10
let radius of middle circle = R and given they are in AP hence, take r = a , R = a+d , r’= a+2d
r’ – r = 10-4=6
a + 2d – a = 6
2d = 6
d = 3
So, R = 4+3 = 7 cm
Circumference of middle circle = 2πr=2π×7=14π

eh:
वृत्त की परिधि का सूत्र इस्तेमाल करने पर = 2πr (जहाँ r त्रिज्या है)
प्रश्न के अनुसार,
छोटे वृत्त की परिधि = 8π
अब, मान लीजिए छोटे वृत्त की त्रिज्या = r
2πr = 8π
r = 4
इसी तरह, प्रश्न के अनुसार
2πr’ = 20π (r’ सबसे बड़े वृत्त की त्रिज्या है)

मान लीजिए बीच वाले वृत्त की त्रिज्या = R है और यह दिया गया है कि वे AP (समांतर श्रेणी) में हैं, इसलिए r = a, R = a+d, r’ = a+2d लीजिए।
r’ – r = 10-4 = 6
a + 2d – a = 6
2d = 6
d = 3
अतः, R = 4+3 = 7 cm
बीच वाले वृत्त की परिधि = 2πr = 2π×7 = 14π

t: The sides of a triangle ABC, AB: BC: CA with base BC, are in the ratio 5: 3: 6. The height of triangle ABC is 4√14 cm. Find the length of CA.
e: Let the length of AB = 5X cm, BC = 3X cm and CA = 6X cm respectively. Semi-perimeter of triangle = (14X)/2 = 7X cm Area of triangle = Given Base = 3X cm Height = 4√14 cm So, 1/2* base* height = 2X2* √14 ½* 3X* 4√14 = 2X2* √14 X = 12/4 = 3 So, length of CA = 6* 3 = 18 cm.

t: When a wire is bent in the form of a square, then the area enclosed by it is 5929 cm². If wire is bent into the form of a circle, then what will be the area enclosed by the wire?
e: Area of square (a^2) = 5929 => a = sqrt(5929) = 77 cm Length of the wire = 4a = 4 * 77 cm = 308 cm If this wire is bent in the form of a circle, then 2pi r = 308 => 2 * (22)/(7) * r = 308 => r = 7 * 7 = 49 cm Area enclosed by wire = pi r^2 = (22)/(7) * 49 * 49 = 7546 cm²
h: जब एक तार को एक वर्ग के आकार में मोड़ा जाता है, तो इसके द्वारा परिबद्ध क्षेत्रफल 5929 सेमी² होता है। यदि तार को एक वृत्त के आकार में मोड़ा जाए, तो तार द्वारा परिबद्ध क्षेत्रफल कितना होगा?

e:

Let the length of the other diagonal be = D cm
Therefore; D<sup>2</sup> + 16<sup>2</sup> = 2(12<sup>2</sup>+ 14<sup>2</sup>)
=> D<sup>2</sup> + 256 = 2(144+ 196)
=> D<sup>2</sup> = 680 - 256 = 424
=> D = 20.6 cm

t: A trapezoid is circumscribed around a circle. The lengths of the non-parallel sides are given as 10 cm and 12 cm. Determine the perimeter of the trapezoid.
e: In a trapezoid: Sum of parallel sides = Sum of non-parallel sides Since the sum of the opposite sides must be equal, the sum of the two parallel sides is also 22 cm. Thus, Perimeter = (Sum of non-parallel sides) + (Sum of parallel sides) = 22 cm + 22 cm = 44 cm
h: एक वृत्त के चारों ओर एक समलंब चतुर्भुज बना हुआ है। इसकी असमान्तर भुजाओं की लंबाई 10 cm और 12 cm दी गई है। इस समलंब चतुर्भुज का परिमाप ज्ञात कीजिए।
eh: एक समलंब चतुर्भुज में: समांतर भुजाओं का योग = असमांतर भुजाओं का योग चूँकि विपरीत भुजाओं का योग बराबर होना चाहिए, इसलिए दो समांतर भुजाओं का योग भी 22 cm है। अतः, परिमाप = (असमांतर भुजाओं का योग) + (समांतर भुजाओं का योग) = 22 cm + 22 cm = 44 cm

t: The area of a square shaped field is 1764 m<sup>2</sup>. The breadth of a rectangular park is 1/3<sup>rd </sup>of the side of the square field and its length is two times its breadth. What is the cost (in ₹) of levelling the park at ₹15 per m<sup>2</sup>?
e:
Area of square field = 1764
Side of square field = √1764 = 42 m
Breadth of rectangular park = 42 * 1/3 = 14 m
Length of rectangular park = 14 * 2 = 28 m
Area of rectangular park = 14 * 28 = 392 sq.m
Cost of levelling park at Rs.15 per sq. m = 15 * 392 = Rs.5880
h: एक वर्गाकार खेत का क्षेत्रफल 1764 m<sup>2</sup> है। एक आयताकार पार्क की चौड़ाई, वर्गाकार खेत की भुजा की 1/3 भाग है और इसकी लंबाई इसकी चौड़ाई की दोगुनी है। ₹15 प्रति m<sup>2 </sup>की दर से पार्क को समतल करने की लागत (₹ में) कितनी है?

t: A circular garden of radius 'R' has a drain of 7m around it. If the area of drain around the garden is 462m<sup>2</sup> then find the value of R (in m).
e:
Radius of the circular garden = R
Radius of the circular garden with drain = R + 7
(Area of circular garden with drain) - (Area of circular garden) = 462 m<sup>2</sup>
Π(R+7)<sup>2</sup> - πR<sup>2</sup> = 462
22/7 * (R<sup>2</sup> + 49 + 14R - R<sup>2</sup>) = 462
14R + 49 = 21 * 7
2R + 7 = 21
2R = 14
R = 7m
h: त्रिज्या 'R' वाले एक वृत्ताकार बगीचे के चारों ओर 7 मीटर की नाली है। यदि बगीचे के चारों ओर नाली का क्षेत्रफल 462 वर्ग मीटर है, तो R का मान (मीटर में) ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: The ratio between the radius of a circle and the side of an equilateral triangle is 9: 4 and the circumference of the circle is 198/7 cm. Find the perimeter of triangle.
e:
Let the radius of the circle be 9X and side of the triangle be 4X.
Circumference of the circle = 198/7
2 x π x (9X) = 198/7
2 x (22/7) x (9X) = 198/7
X = 1/2
Therefore, the side of the triangle be 4 x (1/2) = 2 cm
Perimeter of triangle = 2 + 2 + 2 = 6 cm

Where 'a' and 'b' is the length of parallel sides of the trapezium and 'h' is the perpendicular distance between those two parallel sides.

= 55 * 10
= 550 metre<sup>2</sup>

t: A circular embankment is constructed with a radius of 45 meters. A second concentric circular embankment is built around the first, with a width of 15 meters. What is the approximate area of the region between the two embankments?
e:
Inner radius (r) = 45 m (given)
A second embankment is built around it with a width of 15 m.
Outer radius (R) = 45 m + 15 m = 60 m
Area of region between two embankments:
= π (60² - 45²) m²
= (22/7) × 105 × 15
(using a² – b² = (a+b)*(a-b))
= 4950 m²
h: 45 मीटर त्रिज्या वाला एक गोलाकार तटबंध बनाया गया है। पहले तटबंध के चारों ओर एक दूसरा संकेंद्रित गोलाकार तटबंध बनाया गया है, जिसकी चौड़ाई 15 मीटर है। दोनों तटबंधों के बीच के क्षेत्र का अनुमानित क्षेत्रफल कितना है?
eh:
अंदर की त्रिज्या (r) = 45 m (दिया गया है)
इसके चारों ओर 15 m चौड़ाई का एक दूसरा तटबंध बनाया गया है।
बाहर की त्रिज्या (R) = 45 m + 15 m = 60 m
दोनों तटबंधों के बीच के क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल:
= π (60² - 45²) m²
= (22/7) × 105 × 15
(सूत्र a² – b² = (a+b)*(a-b) का उपयोग करके)
= 4950 m²

t: The area of a square is 1024 sq.m. What is the perimeter of a rectangle whose length is twice the side of the square and the breadth is half the side of the square?

Therefore length of the rectangle = 2*32 = 64 m
Therefore breadth of the rectangle = (1/2)*32 = 16 m

t: A wheel makes 700 revolutions to cover a distance of 77 kilometres. What will be the diameter of the wheel?
e:
Distance covered by wheel in 1 revolution = π*diameter
Therefore distance covered in 700 revolutions = 700* π*diameter
According to question, 700* π*diameter = 77*1000
Diameter = 77*1000*7/(22*700) = 35 m
Hence, the diameter of wheel is 35 m.

h: एक त्रिभुजाकार खेत, जिसका आधार 36 m और ऊँचाई 20 m है, एक आयत के साथ एक भुजा साझा करता है; इस आयत की लंबाई 36 m और चौड़ाई 18 m है। संयुक्त क्षेत्रफल और कुल क्षेत्रफल में त्रिभुज के क्षेत्रफल का प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।
eh:

कुल क्षेत्रफल में त्रिभुज के क्षेत्रफल का % = (360/1008) × 100
= 35.7%

t: An L- shaped floor is made of two rectangles (5m x 3m and 7m x 6m). Tiles cost ₹500/m<sup>2</sup>, but a 15% discount is given if more than 60m<sup>2</sup> is tiled. What is the total cost after the discount?
e:
Area of rectangle<sub>1</sub> with dimension 5 m × 3 m = 15 m²
Area of rectangle<sub>2</sub> = 7 m × 6 m
= 42 m²
Total Area = 15 m² + 42 m² = 57 m²
Sine, the area is less than 60 m², so no discount is applicable.
Total cost = 57 m² × 500 ₹/m²
= ₹28,500
h: L-आकार का एक फ़र्श दो आयतों (5m x 3m और 7m x 6m) से बना है। टाइल्स की कीमत ₹500/m² है, लेकिन अगर 60m² से ज़्यादा जगह पर टाइल्स लगवाई जाती हैं, तो 15% की छूट दी जाती है। छूट के बाद कुल लागत कितनी होगी?
eh:
आयत 1 का क्षेत्रफल (जिसकी विमाएँ 5 m × 3 m हैं) = 15 m²

= 42 m²

कुल लागत = 57 m² × 500 ₹/m²
= ₹28,500

t: Maximum value of circumference of a circle inscribed in a square is 176 cm. What is the difference between area of circle and area of square? (take π = 22/7)

t: The area of the circular park is 18634 m<sup>2</sup>. The path around this circular park has width 7 m. Find the area of circular path thus formed?
e: Area of circular park = 18364 m2 Area of circle = πr2 Therefore, πr2 = 18634 r = 11 X 7 = 77 m Area of circular path = π[(r+7)2 - r2)] = π[(77+7)2 - 772)] = π(842 - 772) = π(7056 - 5929) = (22 X 1127)/7 = 161 X 22 = 3542 m2
h: वृत्ताकार पार्क का क्षेत्रफल 18634 m<sup>2</sup> है। इस वृत्ताकार पार्क के इर्द गिर्द बने पथ की चौड़ाई 7 m है। इस प्रकार बने वृत्ताकार पथ का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: The lengths of three sides of a triangle are in the ratio 3:4:5. Among three sides, the difference between the largest side and the smallest side of this triangle is 3.6 cm. The area [in cm²] of the triangle is:

eh: तीन भुजाओं की लंबाई का अनुपात =3 : 4 : 5 [जो कि त्रिक है इसलिए त्रिभुज समकोण है-त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ 3x, 4x, 5x हैं फिर, [5x - 3x] = 3.6 2x = 3.6 ⇒ x = 1.8 Area = × 3x × 4x = 6x2 = 6× 1.8 × 1.8 = 6 × 3.24 =19.44cm2

t: Find the area (in ) of a circle with a maximum radius that can be inscribed in a rectangle of length 22 cm and breadth 16 cm.
e:
To fit perfectly inside a rectangle without overlapping the edges, the circle's diameter must be equal to the shorter side of the rectangle.
So, diameter = 16 cm
i.e., Radius (r) = 8 cm
Thus,
Area = π × r<sup>2</sup>
= π × 8<sup>2</sup>
= 64 π
h: उस वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल (cm² में) ज्ञात कीजिए, जिसकी त्रिज्या अधिकतम हो और जिसे 22 cm लंबाई तथा 16 cm चौड़ाई वाले एक आयत के अंदर बनाया जा सके।
eh:
एक आयत के अंदर किनारों को ओवरलैप किए बिना पूरी तरह से फिट होने के लिए, वृत्त का व्यास आयत की छोटी भुजा के बराबर होना चाहिए।
इसलिए, व्यास = 16 cm
यानी, त्रिज्या (r) = 8 cm
अतः,
क्षेत्रफल = π × r²
= π × 8²
= 64 π

t: An iron triangle has a base 10 cm, height 12 cm. If the density is 7.8 g/cm<sup>3</sup> and thickness is 2 cm, find the mass.
e:
Let the required mass be 'n'.
Density =Mass/Volume
ATQ; 7.8g/cm³=n/(Area × Thickness)
Area of triangle = (1/2) × Base × Height
= (1/2) × 10 × 12 = 60 cm²
Thickness = 2 cm (given)
Now,
7.8g/cm³=n/(60 × 2 cm³)
n = 936 gram
h: एक लोहे के त्रिभुज का आधार 10 cm और ऊँचाई 12 cm है। यदि इसका घनत्व 7.8 g/cm³ और मोटाई 2 cm है, तो इसका द्रव्यमान ज्ञात कीजिए।
eh:
मान लीजिए कि आवश्यक द्रव्यमान 'n' है।
घनत्व = द्रव्यमान / आयतन
प्रश्न के अनुसार (ATQ): 7.8 g/cm³ = n / (क्षेत्रफल × मोटाई)
त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल = (1/2) × आधार × ऊँचाई
= (1/2) × 10 × 12 = 60 cm²
मोटाई = 2 cm (दिया गया है)
अब,
7.8 g/cm³ = n / (60 × 2 cm³)
n = 936 ग्राम

t: The area of a right-angled triangle is 60 sq. cm. If one of the sides forming the right angle is 15 cm, what is the length of the other side forming the right angle?

In the right-angled triangle, out of two sides that are containing the right angle, one works as the base and the other works as the height.

60 = (1/2) x 15 x height

t:

length of the base of a triangle is 3 cm smaller than the length of

base?
e: let length of altitude = a then length of base = a – 3 Now: Area = × base × Height ⇒ 104 = × [a – 3][a] = 208 = a2 - 3a = a2 - 3a – 208 = 0 ⇒ [a – 16][a + 13]=0 a =16 or a = - 13. So a =16, then base =16 - 3 =13cm.

eh: माना ऊँचाई की लंबाई = a तो आधार की लंबाई = a – 3 अब: क्षेत्रफल = × आधार × ऊँचाई ⇒ 104 = × [a – 3][a] = 208 = a2 - 3a = a2 - 3a – 208 = 0 ⇒ [a – 16][a + 13]=0 a =16 or a = - 13. So, a =16, आधार =16 - 3 =13cm.

t: A circular garden having a diameter of 12m is surrounded by a concrete path that is 2 m wide. Calculate the percentage increase in area resulting from the addition of the path.
e:
diameter = 12 m
radius = 6 m

Area (initial) = π × (6)² = 36π cm²
Final area (including path that is 2 m wide) = π × (8)² = 64π cm²

Percentage change:
= (64π - 36π)/36π × 100
= 28π/36π × 100
= 77.77%
≈ 78% (Approx)
h: 12 मीटर व्यास वाले एक गोलाकार बगीचे के चारों ओर 2 मीटर चौड़ा कंक्रीट का रास्ता बना हुआ है। इस रास्ते को जोड़ने से बगीचे के क्षेत्रफल में हुई प्रतिशत वृद्धि की गणना कीजिए।
eh:
व्यास = 12 m
त्रिज्या = 6 m

क्षेत्रफल (शुरुआती) = π × (6)² = 36π cm²
अंतिम क्षेत्रफल (2 m चौड़े रास्ते सहित) = π × (8)² = 64π cm²

प्रतिशत परिवर्तन:
= (64π - 36π)/36π × 100
= 28π/36π × 100
= 77.77%
≈ 78% (लगभग)

r = 2/3

t: Three circles of radius 6 cm are kept touching each other. The string is tightly tied around these three circles. What is the length of the string?
e: Length of string = 2pi r + 3d = 12pi + 36 cm
h: 6 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले तीन वृत्त एक-दूसरे को स्पर्श करते हुए रखे गए हैं। इन तीनों वृत्तों के चारों ओर एक डोरी कसकर बांधी गई है। इस डोरी की लंबाई कितनी है?

t: If diagonal of a square is (a + √6) cm and area of square is A, then which of following expression is equal to the value of 2A?
h: यदि एक वर्ग का विकर्ण (a + √6) cm है और वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल A है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा व्यंजक 2A के मान के बराबर है?

t: The area of an equilateral triangle is sq. cm. Find the circumference (correct to one decimal place) of a circle whose radius is equal to the side of this triangle.

t:

h:
15 cm त्रिज्या वाली एक गोलाकार सजावटी दीवार घड़ी का डिज़ाइन ऐसा है कि उसकी परिधि पर स्थित दो बिंदुओं को एक जीवा जोड़ती है। यह जीवा, दो त्रिज्याओं के साथ मिलकर, घड़ी के केंद्र पर एक समबाहु त्रिभुज बनाती है। इस जीवा द्वारा निर्मित छोटा खंड एक विपरीत रंग से रंगा गया है। ज्ञात लगाइए कि घड़ी के कुल क्षेत्रफल का कितना प्रतिशत हिस्सा यह छोटा रंगा हुआ खंड दर्शाता है?

t: A right triangle has sides 5 cm, 12 cm and 13cm. A smaller triangle is drawn inside it with its vertices on the sides of the larger triangle, such that it is similar to the larger triangle. If its perimeter is 13.5cm, what is its area?
h: एक समकोण त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ 5 cm, 12 cm और 13 cm हैं। इसके अंदर एक छोटा त्रिभुज बनाया गया है, जिसके शीर्ष बड़े त्रिभुज की भुजाओं पर स्थित हैं, और जो बड़े त्रिभुज के समरूप है। यदि इसका परिमाप 13.5 cm है, तो इसका क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा?

t: A sector of a circle with a radius of 12 cm has a central angle of 90°. Another sector of the same circle has a central angle of π/3 radians. What is the ratio of the area of the first sector to the area of the second sector?
h: 12 cm त्रिज्या वाले एक वृत्त के एक त्रिज्यखंड का केंद्रीय कोण 90° है। उसी वृत्त के एक अन्य त्रिज्यखंड का केंद्रीय कोण π/3 रेडियन है। पहले त्रिज्यखंड के क्षेत्रफल और दूसरे त्रिज्यखंड के क्षेत्रफल का अनुपात क्या है?

t: A triangular sail has a base 12 m and height 9 m. To increase its area by 20% without changing the base, by what percent must the height increase?
h: एक तिकोने पाल का आधार 12 m और ऊँचाई 9 m है। आधार को बिना बदले, इसके क्षेत्रफल को 20% बढ़ाने के लिए, इसकी ऊँचाई को कितने प्रतिशत बढ़ाना होगा?

t: A regular hexagonal nut has an outer side 6 cm and inner hollow side 3 cm. What is the material approximate area in the cross-section?
h: एक नियमित षट्भुजाकार नट की बाहरी भुजा 6 cm और भीतरी खोखली भुजा 3 cm है। इसके अनुप्रस्थ काट में प्रयुक्त सामग्री का अनुमानित क्षेत्रफल कितना है?
